description: SHADOW variant of menivor-reels.json: same metrics and plan code, every charge amount 0 so Rago only records reel/LLM usage and can never produce a non-zero invoice. Use while Menivor bills through its own credit packs (Creem); switch to menivor-reels.json only when Rago becomes the charge of record.

billable_metrics.name: Reels generated
billable_metrics.description: One event per billable reel produced. Counted, not summed.

billable_metrics.name: Reel render seconds
billable_metrics.description: Output video duration billed per whole second. `properties.seconds` carries the quantity.

billable_metrics.name: Reel AI credits
billable_metrics.description: AI model credits (LLM / image / voice) consumed by the render. `properties.credits` carries the quantity.

billable_metrics.name: Menivor LLM calls
billable_metrics.description: One event per LLM call Menivor routes through Relay (videogen apps/api/app/integrations/railyard/metering.py, RAILYARD_RAGO_LLM_METRIC). `properties` carries calls, model, provider, prompt_chars, completion_chars, routed_via. Counted, not summed. Token spend is recorded by Relay itself; this metric is the per-product call count.

plans.name: Menivor Reels
plans.description: Shadow mirror: all charges $0 (usage visibility only).

sample_events.note: POST /reels/usage { render_id, external_subscription_id, generated: true, render_seconds: 30, ai_credits: 8 } expands into one reel_generated event plus reel_render_seconds (properties.seconds) and reel_ai_credits (properties.credits) events, idempotent by render_id.

POST /events { event: { transaction_id: 'llm:<request_id>', external_subscription_id, code: 'menivor_llm_call', properties: { calls: 1, model, provider, prompt_chars, completion_chars, routed_via } } } — one per Relay-routed call.
